# Sample SMS for the v2 parser rules (PLAN.md section 4, rules 1–11)
# Format: SENDER | BODY | amount ; type ; merchant ; mode ; kind ; category   — or IGNORE
# mode "none" means no payment mode was found.
# Made-up messages in common Indian formats. Add real ones from your phone (remove account numbers).

# --- Bank SMS (kind = bank) ---

# --- Receipts from shops / govt (kind = receipt, always expense) ---

BZ-TNEBPY-S | Rs.640.00 paid successfully for electricity bill via UPI. Receipt No EB556677. | 640.00 ; expense ; Tnebpy ; UPI ; receipt ; Bills

# --- Check this (kind = check: amount but no account and no receipt wording) ---
BZ-DMARTS-S | Thank you for shopping at DMart. You paid Rs 1,234.50. Visit again! | 1234.50 ; expense ; Dmart ; none ; check ; Others
